title: Interoceptive axons are unmyelinated or lightly myelinated

statements.text: Interoceptive neurons are of an old evolutionary vintage. Their axons are poorly myelinated or not myelinated, so they are poorly insulated, slow, and open to molecules in their surround. In mammals around 80 percent of vagal fibers are unmyelinated.

sources.quote: their axons are poorly myelinated or not myelinated at all, which means that they are poorly insulated

sources.locator: 4(b) the unique features of the vagus nerve system
sources.quote: In mammals, around 80% of vagal fibres are unmyelinated
